claim: On 2026-04-21 Lambda added support for Amazon S3 Files, so functions can mount Amazon S3 buckets as file systems and perform standard file operations without downloading data for processing; S3 Files is built using Amazon EFS.
note: d135. GA before 2026-07-15, so examinable by date, but older questions answer shared file storage for Lambda with EFS. The guide page configuration-filesystem-s3-files saved empty; SnapStart excludes S3 Files (lambda-snapstart-unsupported-features). adjudicate-18: the capacity-provider condition was removed from claim and scope because no saved quote states it.
